faqs.question: What is RCS Business Messaging?
faqs.answer: RCS Business Messaging enables businesses to communicate with customers using branded, interactive messages containing images, videos, carousels, suggested replies, and action buttons within supported messaging applications.

faqs.question: How is RCS different from traditional SMS?
faqs.answer: Traditional SMS primarily supports text messages, while Rich Communication Services supports richer multimedia content, interactive elements, verified business profiles, and enhanced conversational capabilities on compatible devices.

faqs.question: What is an RCS Business Messaging API?
faqs.answer: An RCS Business Messaging API allows businesses to integrate rich messaging into their websites, applications, CRM systems, and automated communication workflows.

faqs.question: Can businesses use RCS messaging for marketing campaigns?
faqs.answer: Yes. Businesses can use RCS for product promotions, personalized offers, launches, and customer engagement campaigns, subject to consent requirements and applicable messaging policies.

faqs.question: Does RCS support images, videos, and carousels?
faqs.answer: Yes. RCS supports rich media, including images, videos, and interactive carousels, allowing businesses to create more engaging messaging experiences.

faqs.question: Can customers reply to RCS business messages?
faqs.answer: Yes. Supported RCS experiences allow customers to respond to messages, use suggested replies, and interact with businesses through conversational messaging.

faqs.question: Is RCS Business Messaging available in India?
faqs.answer: Yes. RCS Business Messaging is available in India, although delivery and supported features depend on device compatibility, messaging application, carrier support, and business eligibility.

faqs.question: Can RCS messages be sent to both Android and iPhone users?
faqs.answer: RCS is supported on compatible Android devices and supported iPhones. Availability depends on operating system version, carrier support, messaging settings, and the specific business messaging experience.

faqs.question: How can I integrate RCS into my application?
faqs.answer: You can use MSG91's RCS Messaging API to integrate messaging into supported applications and workflows after completing the necessary business onboarding and setup.

faqs.question: How can I start sending RCS messages using MSG91?
faqs.answer: Create an MSG91 account, initiate RCS business onboarding, complete the required verification and agent setup, and configure your messaging campaigns or API integration.
